name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a precious metals royalty and streaming company focused exclusively on the state of Nevada, one of the world's premier gold mining jurisdictions. The company builds and manages a diversified portfolio of royalty interests and exploration properties through its Exploration Accelerator Model, including a 2% net smelter returns royalty on the Lapon Canyon Gold Project in Mineral County. Nevada Canyon trades on the OTCQX Best Market under the symbol NGLD.
